projects.title: Vision Transformer (ViT) Visual Recognition
projects.shortDescription: Patch-based self-attention neural network for multi-class visual recognition.
projects.fullDescription: Constructed a patch-based Vision Transformer from scratch in PyTorch. Includes patch projection, learnable 1D position embeddings, multi-head self-attention blocks, and MLP classification heads with rigorous ablation studies comparing against standard CNN baselines.
projects.contribution: Designed and trained the entire model from mathematical foundations. Implemented custom self-attention modules, trained with AdamW and cosine annealing schedule, and benchmarked attention rollout maps across benchmark datasets.

projects.title: Real-Time Edge Vision & Object Tracker
projects.shortDescription: High-throughput object detection and tracking optimized for edge devices.
projects.fullDescription: Embedded computer vision system capable of real-time multi-object detection and tracking with sub-15ms inference latency on constrained hardware. Features custom post-training quantization and lightweight backbone integration.
projects.contribution: Formulated the INT8 post-training quantization pipeline, pruned redundant weights, and integrated the OpenCV video capture loop for robust multi-stream processing.

projects.title: Domain-Adapted Clinical & Semantic Transformer
projects.shortDescription: Fine-tuned transformer model for domain-specific entity extraction and classification.
projects.fullDescription: Fine-tuned a transformer backbone using Hugging Face for domain-specific text classification and token classification with custom attention masking and high-throughput deployment.
projects.contribution: Built the preprocessing and subword tokenization pipeline, executed FP16 mixed-precision fine-tuning, and wrapped the inference engine into a high-throughput REST API.

projects.title: Spectral Neural Speech Denoising Engine
projects.shortDescription: U-Net convolutional architecture for real-time spectral speech enhancement.
projects.fullDescription: A deep convolutional recurrent neural network operating on Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrograms to isolate clean voice signals from non-stationary background noise and ambient distortion.
projects.contribution: Implemented custom complex STFT loss functions, optimized spectrogram generation on GPU, and conducted PESQ and STOI acoustic metric evaluations.

projects.title: AFSAL OS — Operating System Portfolio
projects.shortDescription: A macOS-inspired dark desktop OS portfolio with interactive window management.
projects.fullDescription: Full-featured web desktop environment complete with animated boot sequence, multi-window manager, zsh-style terminal shell, and file-explorer-style project browser.
projects.contribution: Architected the Zustand window management lifecycle, designed the glassmorphic dark design system, and implemented the terminal parser and animation systems.

projects.title: TorchMetrics Deep Learning Evaluation Toolkit
projects.shortDescription: Open-source lightweight metric calculation modules for PyTorch research experiments.
projects.fullDescription: Lightweight modular PyTorch utility library for computing custom segmentation IoU, mAP, and loss curves with multi-GPU DistributedDataParallel (DDP) synchronizations.
projects.contribution: Authored GPU-accelerated vectorized tensor operations, configured automated CI/CD unit testing, and documented reproducible benchmark scripts.
